title: no-throw overrides
description: Colors packages you did not write, from a project you do. `nothrow.overrides.json` sits at your project root, beside its `package.json`, and outranks every other carrier — it is the rung nobody else has to act for you. Each value is the manifest shape minus `files` and `package`: hashes are about a package's own bytes, and the package these colors are about is the key.

version.description: Bumped only on a breaking reinterpretation. A version this reader does not know floors the whole file.

packages.description: npm package name to the colors asserted for it.
